intermediate_failure_causes: Fixture-only iteration: the first LASSO fixture asserted two derived pair-feature columns and used an invalid flatnonzero conversion; the recorded mask has three columns.

Fixture-only iteration: the first stability fault lowered an edge whose gene stayed reachable through pathway membership, so the re-derivation legitimately matched; the fault now removes the only stable support reaching the asserted pathway.
Native model-use inspection initially required a flat episode list; the finalized materializer records episodes under folds. Both documented layouts are now accepted and anything else is rejected.
One case asserted a KeyError for a malformed episode record; the replay now validates the record shape explicitly and raises ValueError, with a separate absent-file case.
test_substitutes: Recorded synthetic LASSO evidence; fit_context_lasso and every optimizer remain forbidden.
Frozen checkpoint/model containers supplied to the actual downstream inspectors.
scope_limit: Each completed SC-HHGT episode records its LASSO response summary and the localized coefficient/stability edges the HGT model consumes. Signed single-cell model-use inspection now rebuilds the candidate nodes, the three LASSO-derived pair-feature columns and the sparse edge tensors from those recorded values plus the pinned static graph assets, then compares them to the payload: response identity, edge ordering, uniqueness, availability, node sets and localized edges. Rehashed coefficient, stability, node, pair-feature and identity edits fail closed, and an unavailable response may not carry evidence. Integer identities are compared exactly while float32-recorded values use a 1e-6 tolerance; a stability value inside that tolerance of the threshold is reported as a distinct boundary condition. The recorded coefficients are never re-solved, so their fit provenance and L1 objective consistency stay declared gaps. No LASSO, PCA or neural fitting ran; no real cohort, acquisition, paid compute or deployment ran. Earlier scope deviations remain recorded.
